messages:
maria: FYI seeing a sustained p95/p99 token latency uplift on eu-west GPU fleet over last 8m. starts ~2312344200. might be a noisy slab burst pattern from a tenant hitting long-context batches. :thinking_face:
alex: can you paste the query?
maria: prometheus: 
```
  max_over_time(request_latency_seconds{region="eu-west",component="inference"}[10m])
```
shows a clear plateau around 320ms on subset of hosts.
jin: i pulled pod-to-host map, looks correlated to hosts: host-gpu-47/48/49. GPU mem churn is high and nvlink tx errs spiking.
tj: nvlink errs + slab fragmentation => tasks spilling to host memory + egress queueing. any bg batch jobs scheduled?
alex: @srebot did a maintenance job land?
srebot: deploybot: canary job "tensor-sync-compact" executed in eu-west at 2312344105 (controller-pool). No failures reported.
oliver: that job has a compaction phase that pins 100% of one GPU for ~30s repeatedly. if three jobs ran on adjacent hosts we could see cross-host egress tail.
jin: confirmed: tenant "viz-analytics" had 3 active slots pinned to those hosts. their profile shows repeated long sequences and kv-cache thrash.
maria: proposal: preemptively quarantine host-gpu-47 and host-gpu-48, drain workloads to dedicated pool-d3 (reserved) to stop noise while we investigate. quarantine window 30m-1h.
tj: agreed, do a soft-quarantine (route new allocations away) first. full drain if soft doesn't cut it.
alex: cost note: moving to pool-d3 will increase short-term unit cost ~+7-10% for those allocations. fine given SLO risk.
jin: commands i'd run:
```
# soft quarantine (mark hosts unsched)
kubectl -n infra annotate node host-gpu-47 redwood/quarantine=soft --overwrite
# route policy tweak
curl -X POST $ROUTER/api/v1/pools/route -d '{"avoid_hosts":["host-gpu-47","host-gpu-48"]}'
```

maria: i'll run the annotate and policy change now. starting soft quarantine.
alex: i can kick off a targeted memcheck and capture nvml logs for 10m: `nvmlmon --target host-gpu-47 --duration 600 --out /tmp/nvml-47.log`
jin: after quarantine, let's watch tail latency and egress bytes per host. grafana -> "EU GPU host overview" panel and set 1m resolution.
maria: done: annotated + router change posted. route change id: r-9821.
srebot: routing: policy update r-9821 applied, 42 inflight allocations re-routed.
maria: early signal: p99 dropped from 520ms -> 230ms on affected routes within 90s. :relieved:
oliver: nice. keep quarantine for 45m then reassess. i'll open a small canary to repro the slab bursts in a dev pool.
tj: long term: we should add an auto-quarantine heuristic for host nvlink/egress anomalies and a fallback to reserved pool to avoid manual costs. file a ticket?
alex: created ticket INFRA-1249: "auto-quarantine + reserved-fallback for nvlink/egress noisy neighbor" with proposed rollout plan.
maria: notes for postmortem: tenant quota mispredict + compaction job scheduling density -> slab fragmentation -> egress tail -> cross-host impact. mitigation: soft-quarantine + dedicated fallback.
jin: will attach nvml logs and kube events to the ticket.
maria: thanks all — leaving hosts quarantined for 40m, monitoring. :eyes:
